verdict_ko: PR149가 추가한 정상 3자 order guard 경로에서 신규 회귀는 확인하지 못했다. 확인된 세 항목은 모두 상속된 문제이며 미수정 OPEN이다. 소스 검토만 수행했고 컴파일·실행으로 증명한 결과가 아니다.

normal_three_character_guard_review.scope: GetDim failure NDim=0, immediate helper/FieldIO Status guards, ExtOrder preservation and ExtOrderStr blank initialization. Existing valid dimension/name permutations are retained; valid unused ExtOrderStr slots are now defined blank. This is not a new runtime validation claim.

findings.source_evidence: wrf_get_var_info NETCDF branch passes eight explicit arguments. ext_ncd_get_var_info requires nine: the eighth is WrfType and the ninth is Status. The wrapper supplies its Status as the eighth argument and supplies no Status actual argument.
findings.impact_scope: Latent wrapper/API argument mismatch. No repository call to wrf_get_var_info was found in the inspected WRF tree. No runtime failure was reproduced or inferred as observed.
findings.fixture_limit: test_netcdf_zz.F90:134 calls the backend directly with all nine arguments. It does not exercise the module_io wrapper.
findings.inherited_evidence: The same eight-argument call exists in the pre-PR149 baseline 9d7e79182395cd81bc7ed3805126575f64005bc3.

findings.source_evidence: LowerCase and UpperCase use LEN(input) for output substring assignment and per-character writes without comparing LEN(output). GetDim supplies CHARACTER*3 MemOrd. A padded input longer than three characters, even a valid token such as CHARACTER(8) containing zz, can exceed the output substring bounds before the new Status guards. Public field read/write instead first assign TRIM(ADJUSTL(input)) to CHARACTER(3), silently truncating a token such as xyzq to xyz.
findings.impact_scope: Length and normalization policy is unresolved for long/padded direct-helper and variable-info API arguments. Existing ordinary three-character paths are unaffected by this observation. No compiled bounds reproduction was run.
findings.fixture_limit: The selected 20 valid and five invalid helper tokens are CHARACTER(3); variable-info output mo is also CHARACTER(3). Long padded input, long output buffer, and overlength nonblank rejection are not exercised.
findings.inherited_evidence: LowerCase/UpperCase and public read/write CHARACTER(3) normalization already exist in pre-PR149 baseline 9d7e79182395cd81bc7ed3805126575f64005bc3.

findings.source_evidence: FieldIO calls GetTimeIndex before GetDim. For IO=write, GetTimeIndex can update DH%TimeIndex, DH%Times and the NetCDF Times variable before FieldIO rejects a bad memory order. The new guard stops field dispatch but does not make invalid direct writes free of time-bookkeeping side effects.
findings.impact_scope: Direct FieldIO invalid-write rejection is not transactional. Public ext_ncd_write_field checks GetDim before reaching this helper. No invalid-write runtime reproduction was run.
findings.fixture_limit: test_netcdf_zz.F90:128 invokes invalid FieldIO read at an existing date and verifies the data buffer remains unchanged. It does not test invalid direct write with a new date or Times/TimeIndex preservation.
findings.inherited_evidence: The GetTimeIndex-before-GetDim order and time mutations exist in pre-PR149 baseline 9d7e79182395cd81bc7ed3805126575f64005bc3.

current_direct_fixture_scope.cc_getdim_helper_mismatch: Inherited and explicitly excluded by README

next_integration_limit: This review does not describe or approve a subsequent integration fix. All three findings remain OPEN until separately reviewed changes and meaningful tests are completed.
